Compute the edge betweenness of an htna network

Source: R/edge_betweenness.R
edge_betweenness_htna.Rd

edge_betweenness_htna() computes the edge betweenness of an htna network. The betweenness of an edge is the number of shortest paths between pairs of codes that pass through it. Edges with high betweenness are the bridges of the interaction: transitions through which much of the flow between otherwise distant codes must pass. In a heterogeneous network the high-betweenness edges are often hand-overs between actors, which shows which exchanges hold the interaction together.

edge_betweenness_htna() computes the betweenness of every non-zero edge and returns a copy of the network whose edge weights are these scores, with the actor partition kept, so the result can be drawn with plot_htna() and tabulated with as.data.frame.htna(). By default a larger transition probability is a shorter distance (invert = TRUE), as in transition network analysis.

To draw the result directly use plot_edge_betweenness_htna(); for node-level betweenness use centralities_htna().

Usage

edge_betweenness_htna(x, directed = TRUE, invert = TRUE)

Arguments

x

An htna network from build_htna().

directed

Follow edge direction in shortest paths. Default TRUE.

invert

Use 1 / weight as the length of an edge. Default TRUE.

Value

An htna network of class c("htna_edge_betweenness", class(x)) whose edge weights are edge-betweenness scores at every position where x has a non-zero transition. as.data.frame() returns one row per edge with its score in weight.

Conditions

htna_bad_input when x is not an htna network.

See also

plot_edge_betweenness_htna(), centralities_htna(), as.data.frame.htna()

Examples

data(human_ai)
net <- build_htna(human_ai, actor_type = "actor_type")
#> Metadata aggregated per session: ties resolved by first occurrence in 'session_date' (1 sessions), 'cluster' (42 sessions), 'actor_type' (24 sessions)
eb  <- edge_betweenness_htna(net)
head(as.data.frame(eb))
#>    from      to weight source_actor target_actor
#> 1   Ask    Plan     24           AI           AI
#> 2 Check     Ask      2        Human           AI
#> 3 Check Execute      5        Human           AI
#> 4 Check  Repair      1        Human           AI
#> 5 Check  Report      1        Human           AI
#> 6 Check Specify      2        Human        Human
